scope: Local email sink for actual signup confirmation and password recovery; no external recipient/provider delivery
constraints: Confirmation links and mail bodies contain login capabilities; retain them only in private artifacts, never screenshots or tool output.
The browser first-use path must be executed after Auth restart; preparation alone is not a delivery test.
Mailpit handles Gotrue authentication SMTP only. Feedback OTP uses EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend or development console separately; no Mailpit feedback-OTP claim.

startAttempts.reason: The restored profile consolidates upstream variables in private-restored.env; no separate upstream .env exists.

startAttempts.context: Protected consolidated restored env and persistent restore override; only auth and local mail sink selected with --no-deps.

networkAdaptation.cause: The default Compose network is internal and prevented effective host port publication.
networkAdaptation.change: Mailpit alone also joins the existing maintenance network; API/UI 18025 and SMTP 11025 bind to loopback only.
